notes.title: Fungoids - Steam Version - V1 goes live.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We're pleased to annouce the launch of the first in our range of very retro games on Steam. 

Fungoids takes many classic game themes from the 1980's and blends them together in a simple yet addictive bomb 'em up.

We aim to keep developing the Alpha mode for Fungoids, adding new features over the months and hopefully years to come.

If you love true retro gaming, this is the game for you.

Enjoy,

The JimJamsGames team.
